title: I built an AI-powered trading journal — looking for honest feedback
author: Responsible-Air-9905
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I've been working on a trading journal called **Log Lantern**, and I've finally reached the point where I want to put it in front of actual traders instead of just testing it myself.

The goal was to make it more than just a place to write down trades.

Some of the main features are:

* 📖 **Trading Journal** — detailed trade logging, execution notes, charts, and trade history
* 👁️ **AI Chart Analyzer** — upload a trading chart and have AI analyze things like direction, entry, SL, TP, setups, market structure, and key levels
* 📊 **Analytics Dashboard** — win rate, profit factor, drawdown, equity curve, setup performance, long vs. short performance, and more
* 📅 **Trading Calendar** — see your daily P&L and inspect individual trading days
* 🧠 **Trader Personality AI** — analyzes your trading behavior to identify habits, strengths, weaknesses, emotional patterns, and things you need to improve
* 🎯 **Target Architect AI** — creates mathematical goal and risk roadmaps based on your own account parameters
* ☁️ **Cloud Sync** — keep your journal synced across devices

One of the things I really wanted to focus on was connecting **trading performance with trading behavior**.

Instead of only showing *"you made/lost X,"* I wanted the journal to help answer things like:

**"Why am I performing badly?"**  
**"Which setups actually work best for me?"**  
**"Do I trade differently when I'm emotional?"**  
**"What bad habits keep showing up?"**

This is my first V1, so I'm **not claiming it's perfect**.

I'm actually looking for people to try it and tell me what's wrong with it.

I'd especially appreciate feedback on:

* What's unnecessary?
* What's missing?
* Is the AI analysis actually useful?
* Is anything confusing?
* Would you personally use this regularly?
* What would make you choose it over your current trading journal?

If anyone wants to try it:

[Log Lantern]()

Even if you don't sign up, honest feedback would be appreciated.

I built this myself, so if you find something broken, **please tell me 😂**

Thanks! 🙏
